assertions.assertion: The denial was issued under reason code CO-97.
The payer that made the determination is Cornerstone (Cornerstone United).
The payer determined the service to be bundled and not separately payable.
A clinical indication note exists documenting the patient's presentation.
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations.
The patient has known unspecified atrial fibrillation.
Unspecified atrial fibrillation is coded I48.91.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
Personal history of TIA and cerebral infarction is coded Z86.73.
The note states prolonged cardiac rhythm monitoring is indicated to evaluate for arrhythmia burden and guide anticoagulation management.
The monitoring service is distinct (separately identifiable from the bundled procedure).
The service was medically necessary as documented.
Reconsideration of the denial is being requested / an appeal right exists.
